title: Little Signs
summary: Little Signs is piloting speech-to-sign-language support at a Zimbabwean school. Improved classroom access and participation remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Little Signs is piloting speech-to-sign-language support at a Zimbabwean school. Improved classroom access and participation remain unmeasured.
purpose: Make spoken classroom content accessible to deaf and hard-of-hearing learners.
deployer: King George the 4th Secondary School pilot

ratings.reason: The school pilot aims to improve communication and educational participation; no impact result is reported.
